en: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David.

zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。

ja: 指揮者のために。弦楽器に合わせて。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

ja: えてください、私の正しい神よ。 私の
しみから私を解放してください。 私をあわれみ、私の
en: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
u.src: 1  Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

p.src: 2  You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

ja: えられるのか。 いつまでむなしいものを
en: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.
u.src: 2  You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

p.src: 3  But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

ja: 身のために敬虔な者を
en: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.
u.src: 3  But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

p.src: 4  Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

ja: してはならない。 寝
かにしていなさい。 セラ。
en: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
u.src: 4  Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

p.src: 5  Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.

ja: のいけにえをささげよ。
en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.
u.src: 5  Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.

p.src: 6  Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.

ja: せてくれるのか」と言う者が多くいる。
en: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
u.src: 6  Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.

p.src: 7  You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

ja: えてくださった。 それは
かになったとき以上のものだ。
en: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
u.src: 7  You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

p.src: 8  In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

ja: まわせてくださるからだ。
en: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
u.src: 8  In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.
